NewsArticle.Title: Internet Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: Dark Ages may be offline any time between 10:00 and 11:59 p.m. PDT tonight for scheduled internet maintenance. Be careful, although the game may be operating, you will not be connected to it. Therefore, do not do anything that requires fast internet reaction at that time. For example: combat. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
